convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ColorZerolagRVI' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, plus external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> library for position management (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). The custom indicator and external library require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: Osc1 - ColorZerolagRVI buffer 0 (main line)
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 0, SignalBar, 2) - weighted composite of 5 RVI indicators with factors [0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43]

derived_values.name: Osc2 - ColorZerolagRVI buffer 1 (signal line)
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 1, SignalBar, 2) - smoothed signal line of the composite RVI

derived_values.name: Zero-lag RVI composite
derived_values.formula: Factor1*RVI(period1) + Factor2*RVI(period2) + Factor3*RVI(period3) + Factor4*RVI(period4) + Factor5*RVI(period5), where factors sum to 1.0

other_exits: Long position closed when Osc1 < Osc2 (signal line crossunder) on previous bar while Osc1 > Osc2 on bar before that, if BuyPosClose input is true
Short position closed when Osc1 > Osc2 (signal line crossover) on previous bar while Osc1 < Osc2 on bar before that, if SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT, LOT_MARGIN, LOT_FREE_MARGIN sizing modes; MM=0.1 is the fraction/lot size depending on mode

custom_logic_notes: The ColorZerolagRVI is a zero-lag composite RVI indicator that combines 5 RVI indicators with different periods (8,21,34,55,89) and weighting factors (0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43) to eliminate lag. Entry logic uses a 2-bar comparison: Osc1[1] vs Osc2[1] (previous bar relationship) combined with Osc1[0] vs Osc2[0] (current bar crossover) to detect fresh crossings. Signal is evaluated on bar[SignalBar] where SignalBar=1 by default (previous completed bar). The CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh ensures signals are only processed once per new bar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs allow toggling each direction and close type independently. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit.
external_dependencies: TradeAlgorithms.mqh - provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar
ColorZerolagRVI custom indicator - required as iCustom dependency
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement ColorZerolagRVI indicator: compute 5 RVI values (periods 8,21,34,55,89), weight with factors (0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43), apply smoothing (period 15) for signal line. RVI = (close-open)/(high-low) smoothed approach. Entry: detect crossover of main vs signal line using 2-bar lookback. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions are standard position open/close with SL/TP - can be replaced with simple market orders in backtrader/vectorbt. Margin-based sizing needs LOT/LOT_MARGIN/LOT_FREE_MARGIN mode implementation. New-bar guard is essential - only evaluate signals once per completed H4 bar.
